title: My first visit and a method to return.
content: I went to mall world in my dreams. It's a giant infinitely big shopping center. When I first went I saw some cool things and talked to some people, just like a normal shopping trip. I eventually became lucid and realized it was a dream. Everything became so real looking like real life. I walked around and went to a karaoke bar. I sat and talked to someone about their job, but I eventually woke up again. I wanted to go back but I kept getting stuck until I realized the trick. I had to recreated the feeling of vibration when you leave your body. I did this by imagining I was sliding down a long set of stairs. This allowed me to return to the mall world each time I woke up, which happenned several times. I went back and woke up near the bar again, I went in to see if it was the same people there and it was except it was just the workers and they were sleeping. I woke up one to talk to them and they seemed happy to see me. I wanted to explore more of the mall so I told them I would be back and they seemed really eager asking me how long I would be. I was on a lower level and another customer pointed out a higher level where there was some sort of performance going on. I tried going up the escalator but they were all broken so I got stuck and woke up. I returned to the dream using that stair method but this time u was on the right floor. There was a giant aquarium and I was looking down into the opening. There were giant sharks and whales inside. I felt they could see me because each time I looked over the edge they would swim to the surface to get closer to me. I woke up again but went back, but this time the mall was closing and everyone was leaving. I tried exploring the mall more but there was so many people flowing out it was hard to push through the crowd. One of the people grabbed my arm and forced me to walk out of the mall. I woke up and used the trick to go back again. This time the mall was empty of people and I was in a different section. There was like a hotel area so I went in. It was dark and I felt I was sneaking around. I heard people cleaning with a vacuum cleaner so I hid behind a curtain in one of the rooms. A giant cow came in and laid on the bed. I thought it might see the bulge in the curtain, and as soon as I thought that it started sniffing around. It smelled me then went back to the bed and pulled out a large bag of sugar and a coffee maker. It didn't care about the coffee but instead used its nose to suck several pounds of granulated sugar from the bag. I noticed it wasn't a real cow when something inside wearing the cows skin reached out with a long thin black arm tray had long sharp fingers, kind of like a spiders legs. That made me wake up. I decided to write it all down so I don't forget.
